title: First week
body: In this first week using the app I’ve been more productive than the 2 months before! It is amazing, I don’t really know why! Normally I download the app, check it out 1-2 days and then I forget about it or continue procrastinating… but with numo it’s different, maybe because it’s really simple. The 1 missing star is because I sometimes miss some functions like an overview for long term goals etc. but maybe it needs this simplicity to work! I’m really happy by now, time will show if it lasts 😅
author: Rospe🐸
